translation.name: Biblica® Wɔnhia ɛho kwamma nwoma Asante Twi Nkwa Asɛm

content: Bio, mehwɛ mehunuu nhyɛsoɔ a ɛrekɔ so wɔ owia yi ase:

content.text: Mehunuu wɔn a wɔredi wɔn nya no nisuo
tumi no wɔ wɔn nhyɛsofoɔ no nsam
wɔn a wɔda so wɔ nkwa mu no.
Na deɛ ɔyɛ sene baanu yi

content: Na mehunuu sɛ adwumayɛ mu ɔbrɛ ne deɛ onipa tumi yɛ nyinaa nnyinasoɔ ne sɛ, nʼani bere ne yɔnko. Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ, mmirika a wɔtu taa mframa.

content.text: Ɔkwasea bobɔ ne nsa gu ne ho
Nsa ma baako a asomdwoeɛ wɔ mu
yɛ sene nsa ma mmienu a ɔbrɛ bata ho.

content: Afei nso mehunuu biribi a ɛnka hwee wɔ owia yi ase:

content.text: Na ɔbarima bi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ ankonam;
Ɔbisaa ne ho sɛ, “Na hwan na merebrɛ ama no,
na adɛn enti na mede anigyeɛ kame me kra?”
ɛfiri sɛ wɔnya wɔn adwumayɛ so mfasoɔ a ɛsɔ ani:
Nanso onipa a ɔhwe ase a
Bio, sɛ baanu da bɔ mu a, wɔka wɔn ho hye.
Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na ɔkɔntenkorɔ aka ne ho hye?
Ɔbaakofoɔ deɛ, wɔbɛtumi aka no ahyɛ
nanso baanu tumi pere wɔn ti.
Homa a wɔawɔ no mmɛsa no, wɔntumi ntete mu ntɛm.

content: Ɔbabunu nyansafoɔ a ɔdi hia yɛ sene ɔhene akɔkoraa a ɔyɛ kwasea na ɔntie kɔkɔbɔ bio.
Ebia na ɔbabunu no firi nneduafie na ɔbɛdii adeɛ anaasɛ wɔwoo no too ohia mu wɔ adehyeɛ abusua mu.
Mehunuu sɛ wɔn a wɔtenaa ase na wɔnantee owia yi ase nyinaa dii ɔbabunu no akyi, deɛ ɔdii ɔhene no adeɛ no.
Nnipa dɔm a wɔntumi nkane wɔn dii nʼakyi. Nanso nkyirimma no ani annye ne ho. Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ, ɛte sɛ wotaa mframa.
